autoEscape.zh-CN: 是否自动转义 searchWords 中的正则特殊字符。
autoEscape.en-US: Whether to escape regular expression characters in searchWords.

searchWords.zh-CN: 需要高亮的文本：字符串、字符串数组，或带 text、class、style 的对象数组。
searchWords.en-US: Text to highlight: a string, a string array, or an array of objects with text, class and style.

classNames.zh-CN: 内部各部位的类名，键为 highlight（每个高亮标签），值的写法同 class，与组件自带的类名合并；searchWords 中单项的 class 排在其后。
classNames.en-US: Class names of the inner parts, keyed by highlight (every highlight tag); values take any class binding and merge with the built-in classes, followed by the class of a searchWords item.

styles.zh-CN: 内部各部位的样式，键为 highlight（每个高亮标签），值的写法同 style；searchWords 中单项的 style 覆盖同名属性。Vue 不会给数值补 px，长度要写成字符串。
styles.en-US: Styles of the inner parts, keyed by highlight (every highlight tag); values take any style binding, and the style of a searchWords item overrides the same properties. Vue adds no px to numbers, so write lengths as strings.

component.en-US: Tag name of the highlight element.
